limitations: Register remains opt-in; this task does not change decoded defaults.
Focused scalar memory results do not constitute P001 or portfolio/milestone evidence.

The statistics producer separately binds and rechecks the sibling performance TASKS.json; it is outside repository component identity paths.

The full memory-image evidence covers the tested scalar memory workloads and declared fuel points only.
